GTA 6 gameplay footage was just LEAKED before the GTA 6 Netflix Extended Look and GTA 6 Gameplay Trailer 3. A new piece of alleged Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay footage has been LEAKED showing GTA 6 gameplay. It appears to be an unfinished build of Rockstar's highly anticipated open-world GTA 6 game. 

Unlike many fake GTA 6 leaks and fan-made videos that have appeared online, this footage is being closely examined by members of the GTA 6 community who believe the footage could be legitimate. The BIG question: is the GTA 6 leak REAL?

#GTA6Leaks #GTA6News #GTA6Netflix #GTA6Gameplay

GTA 6 Gameplay Just LEAKED Before Netflix Reveal! In this video, we take a look at:

- What the GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Actually Shows
- Why GTA 6 Fans Think the GTA 6 Leaked Footage Is Real
- GTA 6 Leaked Gameplay Footage Has Been Revealed
- Rockstar Issues GTA 6 DMCA Takedown Notices for GTA 6 Leaked Gameplay
- What the New GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Means

The leaked gameplay appears to show an unreleased GTA 6 build running in-game, including gameplay systems, character animations, environmental details and interactions that haven't been publicly demonstrated by Rockstar.

But things get even more interesting. Reports circulating online claim that Rockstar Games / Take-Two Interactive have been issuing DMCA takedowns against copies of the footage, causing the leak to rapidly disappear from social media and other platforms.

So is this actually real GTA 6 gameplay?

In this video, we break down:
- The newly leaked GTA 6 gameplay footage
- What the GTA leaked gameplay actually shows

- And the big question: what other GTA 6 footage could still be out there?

Rockstar has not officially confirmed the authenticity of this specific footage, so everything surrounding the current leak should be treated as unconfirmed unless Rockstar or Take-Two publicly verifies it.

With Grand Theft Auto VI being one of the most anticipated video games in history, even a few seconds of genuine gameplay can reveal more about Rockstar's next open-world than an entire trailer.

Rockstar clearly doesn't want this footage online.

snippet.title: SAM TOMPKINS - HOW TO SAVE A LIFE (THE FRAY COVER)
snippet.description:
Listen to HOW TO SAVE A LIFE (my version): https://SamTompkins.lnk.to/HTSALID

My sophomore album "ARE WE GONNA SING?" is out September 4th 2026. Pre-order now from https://SamTompkins.lnk.to/AreWeGonnaSingID

3 and a half years ago, i was in my living room and i decided to record a cover of one of my favourite songs of all time. i pressed record and as soon as i got the take i new it was special. we posted a vid that night and i went to watch the football… a couple hours later i checked my phone. it was blowing up.

i kept refreshing my page over and over again and it just kept going up. it felt so good. so many people saying the cover took them back to their youth listening to the original like i used to, some were saying it felt like a brand new song to them and to a few it was genuinely a song they hadn’t heard before (this made me feel old).

the following year i posted it again and it blew up even more, but my life was kinda in a strange place. the band who originally wrote the song even commented on one of the videos saying I’d killed it. (I was hoping this was in a good way)

I took a break from releasing music a little while after this cos i lost my dad. my house got robbed also and my old laptop i recorded this on was stolen. 

i came back at the start of this year with some new music. i announced a tour and stuff and was just getting settled back into the swing of things and a few weeks ago on a bit of a random one, i decided to post the cover again. this time it totally went insane. turned out so many of you had been patiently waiting for literal years for me to post it. the fray started interacting with my videos. they told me they preferred my version and then even pushed me to release it.

anyway last week i got in the studio, brought my $200 mic i recorded the original version on and made it happen. i thought I’d lost the original files when my laptop got stolen but found them on a hard drive. 

it’s kinda crazy… some of the vocals here are the same from 2023, before my dad passed, before a lot of stuff happened, and the rest is now where things are so different, but for some reason it feels special. 

i think this song itself has meant so much to me throughout my life and even when recording the original cover, it means something very different to now. that’s what makes music so special. a different voice, melody, a different mindset, any slight change can breath new life into something like this.

anyway, thank you so much for waiting and i’m so grateful. love you guys.

how to save a life (my version) is out now on everything! love you so much !

special thanks to the fray for being so cool throughout this process and even more importantly thanks to you guys for being so supportive as always. 

and on that note, if you wanna be extra awesome and nice and cool, please if you have a chance pre order my album from my store below or grab a ticket to the tour. it would mean infinite amounts to me.

Do you like perfectly balanced games with no exploits? Of Course you do! Thats why you are here watching I (The Spiffing Brit) Destroy the balance of this here wonderful video game! Eversiege Untold ages is an exciting mix of MOBA, Action RTS, Roguelite survival game where you must defend your base from a final boss and his endless army of minions that will be marching down your lane with the goal of destroying your run. Now these enemies are constantly growing stronger so as the player we need to run around the map collecting rogue like upgrades to build an overpowered or synergistic main hero to destroy the opposition. HOWEVER As you can probably see from the steam reviews a lot of people struggle with the difficulty of this game and at higher levels it can feel like an Impossible moba. 

Now I am the spiffing brit breaker of games, finder of exploits, bugs and glitches! So Today I am playing this game because I spent a day investigating a report that someone summoned a clone and it was not deleted. What followed was an absurd amount of trial and error until I finally found a way to exploit the game and create an infintie amount of copies of myself that also inherit all of my stats and potion effects making them absurdly powerful. So Can I beat this Impossible MOBA

snippet.title: Why Starfield is Genuinely An Unacceptable Game
snippet.description:
Save Money on Video Games with Eneba!:

🔗 https://ene.ba/AVVGaming
🎮 https://ene.ba/AVVGaming-Games
🎁 https://ene.ba/AVVGaming-GiftCards

Starfield promised to be Bethesda’s biggest and most ambitious RPG yet, but beneath the scale and spectacle lies a game that often feels strangely devoid of fun. From its endless loading screens and tedious exploration to its outdated systems, lifeless worlds and frustrating design decisions, Starfield frequently seems to work against the very things that made Bethesda’s best games so compelling. In this video, I take a look at how Starfield lost the sense of freedom, discovery and fun that once defined Bethesda’s RPGs, and why, despite all its ambition, it can feel like the antithesis of what makes a great open-world game.

While we're all so excited for Planet Zoo 2 - there's still a bunch of things that many of us can't shake. Where are the non-fish aquatics? Are we able to cohabitat aquariums and habitat species? What about the Exhibit System? And most of all, will we be resold content from Planet Zoo 1? Let's break everything down today and talk about some of the biggest concerns for Planet Zoo 2!
